texts: Why do the Northcove lanterns burn through winter?

fields.sentence: Why do the Northcove lanterns burn through winter?

q2_gaps: a "through <period>" extent adverbial ("burn through winter") - During is explicitly restricted to during/while/throughout, the interval heads Start/End need stated terms, and the named Time role carries only a point, so the throughout-the-season force has no licensed carrier
review.notes: The why-focus pattern with ReasonFor, the Possession + Name encoding of the proper-noun premodifier "Northcove", the definite-plural group binding and the Patient role for intransitive "burn" all match the instruction set. (Time $e winter) is the closest licensed form, but it widens the claim by dropping the "through" extent.
